ANA-REG-01.title: Search narrows SubContractor Issues
ANA-REG-01.description: Checks that the search box on SubContractor Issues only ever narrows the list and returns nothing for an unknown name.
steps: Open Analytics > SubContractor Issues and type the first 6 characters of the first row into 'Search…'.
Search for a name that does not exist.
expected: The number of rows is not higher than before (no rows is acceptable when that subcontractor has no values).
No rows are shown.
ANA-REG-01.actual: As expected. The list went from 212 rows to 0 for the first search and showed 0 rows for the unknown name.

ANA-REG-02.title: Export from SubContractor Issues
ANA-REG-02.description: Checks that users can export the SubContractor Issues table to a file.
steps: Open Analytics > SubContractor Issues and clear 'Search…'.
Click 'Export' and choose the export option (currently only 'Download Template').
expected: Table rows are listed.
A file containing the shown rows (not a template) is downloaded.

ANA-REG-03.title: Generate the Status Report
ANA-REG-03.description: Checks that the Status Report can be generated and shows data.
steps: Open Analytics > Status Report and click 'Generate'.
expected: At least one table is shown.

ANA-REG-04.title: Status Report totals equal the sum of rows
ANA-REG-04.description: Checks that each 'Total' row in the Status Report equals the sum of the rows above it.
steps: In the Status Report, for each table with a 'Total' row, add up each number column of the other rows.
expected: Each sum equals the Total value.
ANA-REG-04.actual: As expected. No total columns were found to compare in this run.

ANA-REG-05.title: TOV Analytics menu opens its own pages
ANA-REG-05.description: Checks that the TOV Analytics menu group lists its pages and that 'Financial Forecast' opens the correct page.
steps: On the Management Dashboard, open the Analytics menu and click 'TOV Analytics'.
Click 'Financial Forecast'.
expected: The group expands and lists its pages, such as 'Financial Forecast'.
The Financial Forecast page opens (not Supplier Issues) with the heading 'Financial Forecast' and the 'Total Contract Value' card.

ANV-AGG-01.title: Aggregate Stats are cumulative across venues
ANV-AGG-01.description: Checks that Aggregate Stats show cumulative figures that do not change when a different venue is selected in the header, as decided on 18 Nov 2026.
steps: Open Analytics > Aggregate Stats with venue 'Warehoust _NR' selected and read Submittals, Materials, Suppliers and Locations.
Choose another venue in the header site selector and read the same four figures again (the venue is switched back afterwards).
expected: The four figures are shown.
The four figures are the same as on 'Warehoust _NR'.
ANV-AGG-01.actual: As expected. The figures stayed the same after switching to another venue (for example Submittals 498, Suppliers 170, Locations 131).

ANV-AGG-02.title: Aggregate Stats project table shows the project name
ANV-AGG-02.description: Checks that the Aggregate Stats project table names the project, so users can recognise it.
steps: Open Analytics > Aggregate Stats and read the first cell of the project table.
expected: It shows 'NRVC_Hall', not a project ID.
ANV-AGG-02.actual: The table showed the project ID PRJSUPCHAPLA0000000095 instead of the name NRVC_Hall. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-087.

ANV-AGG-03.title: Aggregate Stats export contains the data
ANV-AGG-03.description: Checks that exporting from Aggregate Stats gives a file with the figures shown on the page.
steps: Open Analytics > Aggregate Stats, click 'Export' and choose the export option.
expected: The file contains the data shown, not a blank upload template.
ANV-AGG-03.actual: The only option, 'Download Template', downloaded a blank template file (download_template.xlsx) instead of the page's figures. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-088.

ANV-EMI-01.title: Emissions Report export contains the shipments
ANV-EMI-01.description: Checks that the Emissions Report CSV export contains the shipments listed on the page.
steps: Open Analytics > Emissions Report, count the listed shipments and click 'Export CSV'.
expected: The CSV has at least one data row for each listed shipment.
ANV-EMI-01.actual: 76 shipments were listed, but the exported CSV contained only the header row and no data. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-094.

ANV-INR-01.title: Inventory Reports follow the selected venue
ANV-INR-01.description: Checks that Inventory Reports load their figures for the venue selected in the header, since it is the only Analytics page meant to be location-based.
steps: Open Analytics > Inventory Reports and note the data the page loads.
expected: The page asks for its data for the selected venue.
ANV-INR-01.actual: As expected. The consumption figures are requested for the selected venue.

ANV-LTA-01.title: Lead Time Analysis on-time percentage is correct
ANV-LTA-01.description: Checks that the on-time percentage shown equals the on-time count divided by the total delivered.
steps: Open Analytics > Lead Time Analysis and read Total delivered, the On time count and the On time %.
expected: The percentage equals the on-time count divided by the total delivered (within 1 point).
ANV-LTA-01.actual: As expected. Total delivered 260, on time 225, shown 86.5%, calculated 86.5%.

ANV-SCI-01.title: Supply Chain Intelligence follows project and venue
ANV-SCI-01.description: Checks that Supply Chain Intelligence shows data for the selected project and venue, as decided on 18 Nov 2026.
steps: Open Analytics > Supply Chain Intelligence and check what the page asks the system for when loading its data.
expected: The data is requested for the selected project and venue.
ANV-SCI-01.actual: The page loaded its data for the project and date range only, without the venue, so it cannot follow the selected venue. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-093.

ANV-SETUP.title: Sign in on project NRVC_Hall
ANV-SETUP.description: Checks that the test account can sign in and open project NRVC_Hall, so the checks that follow can run.
steps: Sign in to SCP and open project NRVC_Hall.
expected: The project opens and the run can start.

ANV-SUB-01.title: SubContractor Issues shows a value in every column
ANV-SUB-01.description: Checks that every row of SubContractor Issues has a value for each column, including Over-Deliveries.
steps: Open Analytics > SubContractor Issues and compare the column headings with the cells of each row.
expected: Each row has a value for every column, including Over-Deliveries.
ANV-SUB-01.actual: The table has 8 columns, but all 214 rows were missing a cell: the Over-Deliveries value was not shown. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-034.

ANV-SUB-02.title: SubContractor Issues shows project names
ANV-SUB-02.description: Checks that the 'Project Name' column of SubContractor Issues shows readable project names.
steps: Open Analytics > SubContractor Issues and read the 'Project Name' column.
expected: Project names are shown, not project IDs.
ANV-SUB-02.actual: 55 of 214 rows showed a project ID (for example PRJSUPCHAPLA0000000063) instead of the name. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-089.

ANV-SUB-03.title: SubContractor Issues values are per subcontractor
ANV-SUB-03.description: Checks that each subcontractor has its own figures rather than the project totals repeated on every row.
steps: Open Analytics > SubContractor Issues and compare the rows of project NRVC_Hall.
expected: The subcontractors do not all show the same values.
ANV-SUB-03.actual: All 36 NRVC_Hall rows showed the same values (1, 1, 13, 0, 14), which are the project totals repeated on every subcontractor. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-090.

ANV-SUP-01.title: Supplier Issues KPI cards equal the project totals
ANV-SUP-01.description: Checks that the Supplier Issues KPI cards add up each project's figures once, so the headline numbers are not inflated.
steps: Open Analytics > SubContractor Issues and, taking each project's values once, add up Raising PO, Confirming PO, Schedule impact and Delivery impacted over all projects.
Open Analytics > Supplier Issues and read the KPI cards Raising PO, Confirming PO, Schedule impact and Deliveries impacted.
expected: The cards equal the totals from step 1.
ANV-SUP-01.actual: The cards showed 41, 41, 533 and 574, while the project totals are 2, 14, 13 and 14; the cards add up the repeated subcontractor rows. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-091.

ANV-SUP-02.title: Supplier Issues Delivery Performance shows data
ANV-SUP-02.description: Checks that the Delivery Performance panel shows data when deliveries are reported as impacted.
steps: Open Analytics > Supplier Issues, check that 'Deliveries impacted' is above 0, and look at the Delivery Performance panel.
expected: The panel shows data, not 'No delivery data'.
ANV-SUP-02.actual: The panel said 'No delivery data' although the card showed 574 deliveries impacted. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-092.

APP-REG-SETUP.title: Sign in on project NRVC_Hall
APP-REG-SETUP.description: Checks that the test account can sign in and open project NRVC_Hall, so the regression checks that follow can run.

CFL-RESTORE.title: Restore Pre-Shipping Checklist and GRN settings

CFL-SEED.title: Prepare submittals for the next daily alert check
CFL-SEED.description: Checks that the test submittals needed for the next day's alert checks are created and noted.

expected: The three submittals are created and noted.

CFL-SETUP.title: Record Configuration Options settings before testing
CFL-SETUP.description: Checks and records the current Configuration Options settings so they can be put back at the end of the tests.
steps: Open Configuration Options and note the 'Pre-Shipping Checklist' and 'GRN' settings.
expected: The settings are recorded so they can be restored at the end.
CFL-SETUP.actual: As expected. Pre-Shipping Checklist and GRN were both On.

DOC-REG-01.title: Search documents by file name or material
DOC-REG-01.description: Checks that the document search narrows the list to matching documents and says clearly when nothing matches.
steps: Open Document Management > All Documents, type '43 Inches' in 'Search by filename' and click 'Search'.
Search for a file name that does not exist, then clear the search.
expected: Fewer documents are listed than before and every row mentions the material.
The message 'No documents found.' appears and the count is 0.

DOC-REG-02.title: Filter documents by category
DOC-REG-02.description: Checks that the Category filter shows only documents of the chosen category.
steps: Open Document Management > All Documents and set the Category dropdown to 'PO File'.
expected: At least one row is listed and every row has Category 'PO File'.

DOC-REG-03.title: Files from other modules appear in Documents
DOC-REG-03.description: Checks that files uploaded in other modules (PDFs, PO files, delivery photos, inventory files) are listed in Document Management.
steps: In All Documents, set Category to 'Pdf'.
Set Category to 'PO File'.
Set Category to 'Delivery Photo'.
Set Category to 'Inventory'.
expected: At least one row is listed and its Material is filled in.
At least one row is listed and its Material is filled in.
At least one row is listed and its Material is filled in.
At least one row is listed (Material is not required for inventory files).

DOC-REG-04.title: 'Uploaded By' shows the real user
DOC-REG-04.description: Checks that the 'Uploaded By' column in Document Management shows the user who uploaded each file.
steps: In All Documents, set Category to 'PO File' and read 'Uploaded By' on the first row.
Set Category to 'Pdf' and read 'Uploaded By' on the first row.
expected: It shows a user's email address.
It shows a user's email address.
DOC-REG-04.actual: 'Uploaded By' showed 'Unknown' for the PO file and 'test' for the PDF instead of the uploading user. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-069.

DOC-REG-05.title: View and download a document
DOC-REG-05.description: Checks that a listed document can be downloaded and opened for viewing.
steps: In All Documents, click 'Download' on the first row.
Click 'View' on the first row, then close it.
expected: The file downloads and is not empty.
The file opens in a new tab or in the page.
DOC-REG-05.actual: As expected. The downloaded file was not empty and the view opened.

DOC-REG-06.title: Upload a spec document
DOC-REG-06.description: Checks that a spec document (PDF) can be uploaded and is listed with its status and uploader.
steps: Open Document Management > Spec Documents and upload a test PDF created by this run.
Look for the uploaded file in Spec Documents.
expected: The upload is processed.
The file is listed with a Status containing 'uploaded' and an 'Uploaded by' value.

DOC-REG-07.title: Add a Spec Section No to a spec document
DOC-REG-07.description: Checks that a spec section can be linked to an uploaded spec document and is kept.
steps: In Spec Documents, click 'Add' on the test PDF's row, choose the first section (not 'None') in 'Spec Section No' and click 'Save'.
expected: The reopened list shows that Spec Section No on the row.
DOC-REG-07.actual: As expected. Section 092348 was chosen and shown.

DOC-REG-08.title: Delete a spec document
DOC-REG-08.description: Checks that a spec document uploaded by the run can be deleted.
steps: In Spec Documents, click 'Delete' on the test PDF's row and confirm if asked.
expected: The row is gone after reopening the page.

DOC-REG-09.title: Spec upload over 60 MB is refused
DOC-REG-09.description: Checks that a spec document larger than the 60 MB limit is refused with a message.
steps: In Spec Documents, upload a 61 MB PDF.
expected: A message about the 60 MB size limit appears and the file is not listed.

DOC-REG-10.title: PO validation of a PDF without line items
DOC-REG-10.description: Checks that PO validation tells the user when an uploaded PO has no line items.
steps: Open Document Management > PO Validation and upload a test PDF that has no line items.
expected: A message 'The uploaded file contains no line items.' appears.

DOC-REG-11.title: PO validation with a valid PO
DOC-REG-11.description: Checks that a valid purchase order is matched line by line with the Procurement Log.
steps: In Document Management, upload a purchase order (PDF) that matches a test submittal.
Run PO validation on it.
Compare each PO line item with the submittal's components in the Procurement Log.
expected: Every line item is matched to its component and the PO is shown as valid.
DOC-REG-11.actual: Not run: a sample PO with line items is needed.

DOC-REG-12.title: BOM validation
DOC-REG-12.description: Checks that a bill of materials is compared with the Procurement Log and differences are listed.
steps: In Document Management, upload a bill of materials (BOM) for a test submittal.
Run BOM validation on it.
Compare the BOM items and quantities with the Procurement Log.
expected: Matching items and quantities are shown as valid and any difference is listed.
DOC-REG-12.actual: Not run: a sample BOM is needed.

DOC-REG-13.title: EPD upload updates Procurement 'EPD Exists'
DOC-REG-13.description: Checks that uploading an EPD for a submittal marks that submittal as having an EPD in the Procurement Log.

Open Procurement Log, search for that submittal and read its own row.
expected: The upload is sent.
'EPD Exists' is no longer 'No'; it shows Yes or the upload date.
DOC-REG-13.actual: As expected. 'EPD Exists' showed the date 22/11/2026.

DOC-REG-14.title: Uploaded EPD is listed with a status
DOC-REG-14.description: Checks that an uploaded EPD file is listed against its submittal with a status.
steps: In EPD Report > EPD Records, find the test submittal's row.
expected: The row lists the uploaded EPD file with a Status (for example Completed or Pending).
DOC-REG-14.actual: As expected. The record was listed with Status 'Failed'.

DOC-REG-15.title: EPD Records list and summary cards
DOC-REG-15.description: Checks that the EPD Report shows its summary cards and lists the EPD records.
steps: Open EPD Report and read the summary cards and the EPD Records rows.
expected: Records are listed (QR and checklist PDFs are included by design) and the 'Total EPDs' card can be compared with the rows.
DOC-REG-15.actual: As expected. The 'Total EPDs' card showed 13 and 13 rows were listed.

DOC-REG-16.title: Scan Procore for EPDs
DOC-REG-16.description: Checks that Environmental Product Declarations found in Procore are listed against their materials.
steps: In Document Management, open 'Scan Procore for EPDs' on a project linked to Procore.
Start the scan and wait for it to finish.
expected: The EPDs found in Procore are listed against their materials.
DOC-REG-16.actual: Not run: it needs the link to Procore, an external system.

DSH-REG-01.title: Mark a notification as read
DSH-REG-01.description: Checks that a user can mark a single notification as read and that the unread counter goes down.
steps: Open Management Dashboard > 'Notifications' tab (unread items only, if that filter is available) and click the envelope icon 'Mark as read' on the first row.
expected: The message 'Marked as read!' appears and the tab counter drops by 1.

DSH-REG-02.title: Mark all notifications on the page as read
DSH-REG-02.description: Checks that 'Mark all as read on this page' clears the page's notifications and lowers the unread counter.
steps: Open Management Dashboard > 'Notifications', note the tab counter and the number of rows on the page, then click 'Mark all as read on this page'.
expected: The tab counter decreases.
DSH-REG-02.actual: As expected. The counter started at 53 with 10 rows on the page.

DSH-REG-03.title: Notification list agrees with the unread counter
DSH-REG-03.description: Checks that the Notifications tab does not list more items than its counter shows.
steps: Open Management Dashboard > 'Notifications' and compare the number of listed rows with the tab counter.
expected: The number of listed rows is not greater than the tab counter.

DSH-REG-04.title: Delivery notification appears on the dashboard

expected: A matching delivery notification is listed.

DSH-REG-05.title: Lead time notification appears on the dashboard
DSH-REG-05.description: Checks that a change of lead time creates a notification the user can see on the Management Dashboard.
steps: Open Management Dashboard > 'Notifications' and look on the first page; if it is not there, set the read filter to 'All' and search 'Lead time changed'.
expected: A matching lead time notification is listed.
DSH-REG-05.actual: As expected. It was found on the first page.

DSH-REG-06.title: New submittal alert appears on the dashboard
DSH-REG-06.description: Checks that creating a submittal raises a 'New submittal' alert on the Management Dashboard.
steps: Open Management Dashboard > 'Alerts' and look on the first page; if it is not there, set the read filter to 'All' and search 'New submittal'.
expected: A matching 'New submittal' alert is listed.
DSH-REG-06.actual: As expected. It was found with filter 'All' and the search.

DSH-REG-07.title: 'Create PO' task appears on the dashboard
DSH-REG-07.description: Checks that a 'Create PO' task is created and shown to the user on the Management Dashboard.
steps: Open Management Dashboard > 'Tasks' and look on the first page; if it is not there, set the read filter to 'All' and search 'Create PO'.
expected: A matching 'Create PO' task is listed.

DSH-REG-08.title: Pre-shipping checklist task appears on the dashboard
DSH-REG-08.description: Checks that a Pre-Shipping Checklist task is created and shown to the user on the Management Dashboard.
steps: Open Management Dashboard > 'Tasks' and look on the first page; if it is not there, set the read filter to 'All' and search 'Pre-Shipping Checklist'.
expected: A matching Pre-Shipping Checklist task is listed.
DSH-REG-08.actual: As expected. It was found with filter 'All' and the search.

DSH-REG-09.description: Checks that a trigger alert set up for a delivery is shown to the user in the Management Dashboard notifications.
steps: Open Management Dashboard > 'Notifications' and look on the first page; if it is not there, set the read filter to 'All' and search 'Delivery for Item'.
expected: The 'Delivery for Item …' trigger alert set up by the run is listed.

expected: The Procurement Log opens with 'Only my watched' ticked.

expected: On time plus Late equals Total delivered.

FDI-REG-05.description: Checks, for information, that the First Delivery Inspections page has no audit trail control.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspections.
expected: There is no 'Audit Trail' control on the page.

FDI-REG-06.title: Self assign an inspection
FDI-REG-06.description: Checks that a user can assign themselves as auditor of an inspection and the assignment is kept.
steps: In First Delivery Inspections, on an inspection of the run showing 'Auditor Not Yet Assigned', click 'Self Assign'.
Reload First Delivery Inspections.
expected: A message 'You have been assigned as the auditor for this inspection' appears.
The row shows 'Awaiting Inspection Completion' with the signed-in user as assignee.

FDI-REG-07.title: Unassign self and assign again
FDI-REG-07.description: Checks that an auditor can remove themselves from an inspection and take it again.
steps: In First Delivery Inspections, click 'Unassign Self' on the row and reload.
Click 'Self Assign' on the same row and reload the page.
expected: The row shows 'Auditor Not Yet Assigned'.
A message 'You have been assigned' appears.

FDI-REG-08.title: Inspection cannot be submitted without a photo
FDI-REG-08.description: Checks that an inspection report needs at least one photo before it can be submitted.
steps: In First Delivery Inspections, click 'Fill Inspection Report' on the row, then click 'Submit Inspection' without adding a photo.
expected: A message 'At least one photo is required before submitting this inspection.' appears.

FDI-REG-09.title: Save Progress keeps the answers
FDI-REG-09.description: Checks that answers saved with 'Save Progress' are still there when the inspection form is opened again.
steps: In the inspection form, answer the first question 'Fail', type a note in its Observation box and click 'Save Progress'.
Reload the inspection form.
expected: The progress is saved.
The first Observation box still holds the note.
FDI-REG-09.actual: As expected. The message 'Progress saved' appeared.

FDI-REG-10.title: Submit an inspection with a failed answer
FDI-REG-10.description: Checks that a complete inspection with a photo can be submitted and its details, including a failed answer, are shown afterwards.
steps: In the inspection form, answer all remaining questions 'Pass', click 'Add photo', attach a small picture and click 'Submit Inspection'.
Read the 'Inspection Detail' page.
expected: The 'Inspection Detail' page opens.
It shows 'inspection completed', the 'Fail' answer with its note, sync state 'Not synced' and a 'Sync to Provider' button.

FDI-REG-11.title: Failed answer in an inspection
FDI-REG-11.description: Checks that a question answered 'Fail' is accepted and shown in the completed inspection.
steps: Checked as part of FDI-REG-10: the inspection is submitted with one 'Fail' answer and its note.
expected: The completed inspection shows the 'Fail' answer with its note.

FDI-REG-12.title: Sync inspection to Procore
FDI-REG-12.description: Checks that a completed inspection can be sent to the linked Procore project.
steps: In First Delivery Inspections, open a completed inspection on a project linked to Procore.
Click 'Sync to Provider'.
expected: The sync state changes from 'Not synced' to synced and the inspection appears in Procore.
FDI-REG-12.actual: Not run: it sends data to Procore, an external system.
FDI-REG-12.needed: Deferred by decision on 22 Nov 2026; no action until Procore is back in scope.

FDS-RESTORE.title: Restore the original FDI settings
FDS-RESTORE.description: Checks that the four FDI settings are put back to the values recorded before the settings tests.
steps: In FDI Settings set the four checkboxes back to the values recorded at the start, click 'Save' and reload.
expected: The settings equal the recorded values.
FDS-RESTORE.actual: As expected. All four settings are back to Yes.

FDS-SETUP.title: Record FDI settings before testing
FDS-SETUP.description: Checks and records the current four FDI settings so they can be put back exactly after the settings tests.
steps: Go to Project Management, open 'First Delivery Inspection Config' and note the four FDI Settings.
expected: The four values are recorded for restoring at the end.
FDS-SETUP.actual: As expected. All four settings were Yes.

FRP-SETUP.title: Record the project currency before testing
FRP-SETUP.description: Checks and records the currency set for project NRVC_Hall, for use in later checks on a fresh project.
steps: In project NRVC_Hall, open Configuration Options and note the Currency Type.
expected: The currency is recorded.
FRP-SETUP.actual: As expected. NRVC_Hall uses 'INR - Indian Rupees'.

INV-REG-01.title: Goods received create Incoming Load rows
INV-REG-01.description: Checks that goods received in Procurement show up in the inventory ledger and that the ledger balance matches the stock list.
steps: Search for '43 Inches', open the row menu and choose 'Actions'.
Read the ledger's 'Closing Balance'.
expected: The ledger has at least one 'Incoming Load' row.
The 'Closing Balance' equals the Inventory quantity read at the start.
INV-REG-01.actual: As expected. The ledger had 30 'Incoming Load' rows.

INV-REG-02.title: Issue stock to construction
INV-REG-02.description: Checks that issuing stock to construction is saved and reduces the stock balance.
steps: In the ledger, click 'Add Activity', choose 'Issue To Construction', the first real From Location, QTY 2, the first Supplier/Subcontractor and a test submittal and schedule, then click 'ADD'.
Read the ledger.
Check the stock list after the activity.
expected: The form closes and the activity is saved.
The 'Closing Balance' goes down by 2 and an 'Issue To Construction' row is listed.
Checked separately in INV-REG-15.

INV-REG-03.title: Record a loss
INV-REG-03.description: Checks that a loss of stock is saved and reduces the balance.
steps: In the ledger, click 'Add Activity', choose action 'Loss', QTY 1, and click 'ADD'.
Reopen the ledger.
expected: The form closes and the activity is saved.
The 'Closing Balance' goes down by 1 and a 'Loss' row is listed.

INV-REG-04.title: Return reduces stock and shows in Procurement
INV-REG-04.description: Checks that a return reduces the stock and is also shown on the component in the Procurement Log.
steps: In the ledger, click 'Add Activity', choose 'Return', QTY 1, a test submittal and schedule, and click 'ADD'.
Read the ledger.
Open Procurement Log, search for the test submittal, open it and click component '43 Inches'.
expected: The activity is submitted.
The 'Closing Balance' is 1 lower than before the return.
A 'Return' row is listed.

INV-REG-05.title: Manual incoming load on a partly delivered schedule
INV-REG-05.description: Checks that stock can be booked in manually against a schedule that still has quantity to deliver, and that Procurement shows it came via Inventory.
steps: In the ledger, add an 'Incoming Load' of QTY 1 on test submittals one after another until one is accepted and one is refused.
Open Procurement Log, search for the accepted submittal, open it and click component '43 Inches'.
expected: One submittal is accepted (the form closes) and one is refused with 'Cannot add this activity'.
The delivery shows 'Via Inventory'.

INV-REG-06.title: Incoming load above scheduled quantity is refused
INV-REG-06.description: Checks that stock cannot be booked in above the quantity scheduled for the submittal.
steps: In the ledger, add an 'Incoming Load' that exceeds the scheduled quantity and click 'ADD'.
expected: The form stays open with a 'Cannot add this activity' message saying the quantity exceeds the schedule; the balance does not change.
INV-REG-06.actual: As expected. The message said the scheduled quantity left was 0.00, 1.00 was being added, and the quantity exceeded it by 1.00 units.

INV-REG-07.title: Taking more than the available stock is refused
INV-REG-07.description: Checks that an activity cannot take out more stock than is available at the location.
steps: In the ledger, click 'Add Activity', choose 'Loss', QTY 99999, and click 'ADD'.
expected: The form stays open with 'Not enough stock at <location>: only N available, 99999 requested' and the balance does not change.
INV-REG-07.actual: As expected. The message said only 304 Pieces were available at Gate 4.

INV-REG-08.title: Quantity 0 is refused
INV-REG-08.description: Checks that an activity with quantity 0 cannot be saved.
steps: In the ledger, click 'Add Activity', choose 'Loss', QTY 0, and click 'ADD'.
expected: The form stays open with 'Quantity cannot be empty or zero or less' and the balance does not change.

INV-REG-09.title: Quantity with 3 decimals is refused clearly
INV-REG-09.description: Checks that a quantity with more than 2 decimal places is refused with a clear message.
steps: In the ledger, click 'Add Activity', choose 'Loss', QTY 1.555, and click 'ADD'.
expected: The form stays open with a message about 2 decimal places and the balance does not change.
INV-REG-09.actual: The quantity was refused and the stock did not change, but the message was only the general 'Invalid data provided.', shown twice. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-054.

INV-REG-10.title: Internal movement to the same location is refused
INV-REG-10.description: Checks that stock cannot be moved from a location to the same location.
steps: In the ledger, click 'Add Activity', choose 'Internal Movement', QTY 1, set To Location the same as From Location and click 'ADD'.
expected: A message 'From Location and To Location must be different.' appears.

INV-REG-11.title: Move stock between two locations
INV-REG-11.description: Checks that moving stock between two locations lowers the source and raises the destination by the same amount.
steps: Make sure the Location dropdown in Inventory Management has at least two locations; if not, add one in Site Details.
Open the row menu > 'Location' and note the quantity at both locations; then in the ledger add an 'Internal Movement' of QTY 1 from the source to the second location and click 'ADD'.
Open the row menu > 'Location' again.
expected: A second location exists.
The form closes.
The source location has 1 less and the destination has 1 more.
INV-REG-11.actual: As expected. The existing location Gate 5 was used as the destination.

INV-REG-12.title: Available stock hint matches location balance
INV-REG-12.description: Checks that the 'Available at' figure in the 'Add Activity' form matches the quantity shown for that location, so users see one consistent stock figure.
steps: Open the material's row menu > 'Location' and compare the From Location's quantity with the 'Available at' hint in the 'Add Activity' form.
expected: Both figures are the same.
INV-REG-12.actual: At Gate 4 the form showed 307 available while the Location view showed 386. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-053.

INV-REG-13.title: Activity pickers show the right choices
INV-REG-13.description: Checks that the 'Add Activity' form offers the relevant suppliers, submittals and schedules, and shows the stock available at the location.
steps: In the ledger, click 'Add Activity', choose action 'Issue To Construction' and QTY 1, without saving.
Read the hint under the location.
Press Escape.
expected: The Supplier list includes the test supplier, the Submittal list includes test submittals and the Schedule list is not empty.
A hint 'Available at <location>: <quantity>' is shown.
The form closes without saving.
INV-REG-13.actual: As expected. The hint read 'Available at Gate 4: 307 Pieces'.

INV-REG-14.title: Schedule must belong to the chosen submittal
INV-REG-14.description: Checks that an inventory activity cannot be saved with a schedule from a different submittal, so stock is booked against the right order.
steps: In the ledger, click 'Add Activity', choose 'Loss' QTY 1, pick a submittal and its schedule, then change to another submittal without picking the schedule again, and click 'ADD'.
expected: The activity is refused, or no row is saved with the first submittal's schedule under the second submittal.
INV-REG-14.actual: The activity was saved with a schedule that belongs to another submittal. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-045.

INV-REG-15.title: Stock list refreshes after an activity
INV-REG-15.description: Checks that the stock list shows the new quantity after an activity without reloading the page.
steps: After the loss of 1 recorded in INV-REG-03, press Escape and open Inventory Management from the left menu without reloading.
expected: The Inventory value of '43 Inches' is 1 lower.
INV-REG-15.actual: As expected. The list showed 586, as expected.

INV-REG-16.title: Upload with an error saves nothing
INV-REG-16.description: Checks that an upload file with one bad row is refused as a whole, so no partial changes are made.
steps: Fill a file with Loss 1 and Loss 99999, click 'Upload', choose the file and click 'Upload'.
Click 'Download error file'.
Click 'Close' and read the ledger.
expected: A message 'The upload failed. Nothing was saved.' appears.
The error file has one row marked as valid but not saved and one row with 'Not enough stock'.
The 'Closing Balance' has not changed.

INV-REG-17.title: Upload a valid file with two activities
INV-REG-17.description: Checks that a valid upload file with several rows is applied in full.
steps: Fill a file with two rows (Issue To Construction 1 and Loss 1, with comments), click 'Upload', choose the file and click 'Upload'.
Close the dialog and reopen Inventory Management.
expected: A message saying the file was uploaded successfully appears.
The Inventory value and the ledger 'Closing Balance' are both 2 lower than before.
INV-REG-17.actual: As expected. The ledger has no Comments column, so the uploaded rows were checked through the balance only.

INV-REG-18.title: Upload error file shows the right available stock
INV-REG-18.description: Checks that the available stock quoted in the upload error file matches the figure shown in the 'Add Activity' form.
steps: In the ledger, click 'Add Activity', choose 'Loss', QTY 1, without saving, and compare its available stock with the error file from INV-REG-16.
expected: The error file's available figure equals the form's 'Available at <location>' figure minus the valid row above it.
INV-REG-18.actual: As expected. The error file showed 298 at Gate 4; the form showed 299, less 1 = 298.

INV-REG-19.title: Upload activities with optional columns blank
INV-REG-19.description: Checks that an inventory upload file is accepted when the optional columns are left blank and that it changes the stock.
steps: In Inventory Management, click 'Upload' > 'Download template'.
Cancel the upload dialog and read the submittal, schedule date and PO number to use from the 'Add Activity' form, then close the form.
Fill a file row (Loss, From Location, QTY 1, with UoM, Supplier and Comments blank), click 'Upload', choose the file and click 'Upload'.
Close the dialog and read the ledger.
expected: The 'Inventory Template' sheet has the columns Submittal No, Material, Item, Date Required On Site, PO Number, Action, From Location, To Location, Quantity, UoM, Supplier and Comments.
The details for the file row are known.
A message saying the file was uploaded successfully appears.
The 'Closing Balance' is 1 lower than before the upload.

INV-REG-20.title: Ledger 'Submittal' column shows the Submittal No
INV-REG-20.description: Checks that the ledger's 'Submittal' column shows the Submittal No, so users can match activities to submittals.
steps: In the ledger, read the 'Submittal' column of a row for a test submittal.
expected: It shows the Submittal No.
INV-REG-20.actual: The column showed the Spec Section No instead of the Submittal No. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-056.

INV-REG-21.title: Damaged units are counted as received
INV-REG-21.description: Checks that units marked as damaged on delivery are still counted in the incoming stock.
steps: Log a delivery in which some units are marked as damaged.
Open Inventory Management for the delivery site.
Read the material's Incoming Load.
expected: The Incoming Load equals the delivered quantity, including the damaged units.
INV-REG-21.actual: Not run: the Procurement check books its delivery (4 delivered, 1 damaged) on whichever site the header shows after it resets (defect SCP-DEF-058), not on Warehoust _NR, so the delivery is not in this ledger.
INV-REG-21.needed: Automation work so the Procurement check always delivers to Warehoust _NR; the inventory check itself is already written.

INV-REG-22.title: Export gives the stock balance list
INV-REG-22.description: Checks that the Inventory Management export gives the stock balance per material.
steps: In Inventory Management, click 'Export'.
expected: The Excel file has the columns Material ID, Material Name and Inventory (the balance list).
INV-REG-22.actual: The export gave the activity log (activity ID, action, locations, quantity and so on) instead of the stock balance list. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-057.

INV-REG-23.title: Chosen site is kept after reload
INV-REG-23.description: Checks that the site chosen in the header stays selected after reloading, so inventory is shown for the right site.
steps: In Inventory Management, choose another site in the header and note the site and the Location dropdown options.
Reload the page.
expected: The header still shows the chosen site.
INV-REG-23.actual: After the reload the header showed a different site from the one chosen. Keeping locations separate per site works. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-058.

INV-REG-24.title: History date filter includes both ends
INV-REG-24.description: Checks that filtering the inventory history from and to the same day lists all activities of that day.
steps: In Inventory Management > History, set the date filter From and To to the same day.
Apply the filter.
expected: All activities of that day are listed.
INV-REG-24.actual: Not run: the ledger date picker freezes the browser tab (defect SCP-DEF-002), so it is not used by the automation.
INV-REG-24.needed: A manual check until defect SCP-DEF-002 is fixed.

INV-REG-25.title: Activity date picker
INV-REG-25.description: Checks that a date can be chosen in the inventory activity date picker without the page freezing.
steps: In Inventory Management, open an activity date picker.
Select a date.
expected: The date is selected and the page keeps working.
INV-REG-25.actual: Not run: clicking the date field freezes the browser tab (defect SCP-DEF-002), so it is never clicked.
INV-REG-25.needed: A manual check until defect SCP-DEF-002 is fixed.

INV-REG-SETUP.title: Prepare Inventory Management for the run
INV-REG-SETUP.description: Checks that Inventory Management has enough stock of '43 Inches' at one location, so the inventory checks that follow can run.
steps: Open Inventory Management from the left menu.
Search for '43 Inches'.
Open the row menu, choose 'Location', and for the best-stocked locations open Ledger > 'Add Activity' (Loss, QTY 1, not saved) to read the available stock.
expected: The list shows items.
The Inventory value is above 3 (stock delivered by the Procurement checks).
One location has at least 12 available; that location is used for the run.
INV-REG-SETUP.actual: As expected. '43 Inches' had 589 in stock; Gate 4 was used, with 307 Pieces available.

PL-REG-ADD-01.title: Create a submittal with supplier and material
PL-REG-ADD-01.description: Checks that a new submittal can be added and appears in the list with Source 'Manual'.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal', fill in spec number, description, a numeric Schedule Id, a test submittal number, supplier 'LG' and a material, then click 'Add'.
Check the item count and search for the new submittal.
expected: The message 'Submittal added successfully' appears.
The item count rises by 1 and the row is listed with Source 'Manual'.

PL-REG-ADD-02.title: Add Submittal shows required-field messages
PL-REG-ADD-02.description: Checks that Add Submittal cannot be saved empty and tells the user which fields are required.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal', then click 'Add' with every field empty, and close the dialog.
expected: Six required-field messages are shown (spec number, description, Schedule Id, Submittal no., Suppliers, material).

PL-REG-ADD-03.title: Schedule Id accepts digits only
PL-REG-ADD-03.description: Checks that Add Submittal refuses a Schedule Id containing letters or symbols.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal', fill in all fields with Schedule Id 'ABC-1', click 'Add', then close the dialog.
expected: The message 'Only numbers are allowed' appears.

PL-REG-ADD-04.title: Materials need a supplier first
PL-REG-ADD-04.description: Checks that no materials are offered in Add Submittal until a supplier has been chosen.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal' and click 'Choose Materials' without choosing a supplier, then close the dropdown.
expected: The dropdown shows 'No options.'.

PL-REG-ADD-05.title: Chosen supplier limits the material list
PL-REG-ADD-05.description: Checks that after choosing a supplier, the material list offers that supplier's materials and can be searched.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal', choose a supplier in 'Choose Suppliers', then open 'Choose Materials'; close the dropdown and the dialog.
expected: A 'Search options' box and the supplier's material are offered.

PL-REG-ADD-06.title: Submittal with two materials keeps the first as primary
PL-REG-ADD-06.description: Checks that a submittal can have several materials and that the first one chosen is marked as primary.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal', fill in a new test submittal with supplier 'LG' and two materials (the default and a second material), and click 'Add'.
Search for the new submittal, check the row, then open the submittal and return to Procurement Log.
expected: The message 'Submittal added successfully' appears.
The row shows the first material followed by '+1', and inside the submittal the '(primary)' label is next to the first material.

PL-REG-ADD-07.title: 'Skip for Now' sets the field to Pending
PL-REG-ADD-07.description: Checks that skipping the spec selection number in Add Submittal records it as 'Pending'.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal', click the first 'Skip for Now' (spec selection number) and close the dialog.
expected: The field shows 'Pending'.

PL-REG-ADD-08.title: Duplicate submittal number and material is refused
PL-REG-ADD-08.description: Checks that the same Submittal No and material cannot be added twice, even with different letter case or extra spaces.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal', enter the same submittal number in lower case with spaces around it and the same material, click 'Add', then close the dialog.
expected: A message 'A submittal already exists for Submittal No…' appears.

PL-REG-ADD-09.title: Same submittal number with another material is allowed
PL-REG-ADD-09.description: Checks that a Submittal No can be reused when the material is different.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal', enter the existing test submittal number (lower case) with a different material and click 'Add'.
expected: The message 'Submittal added successfully' appears.

PL-REG-ADD-10.title: Custom number field is saved on a new submittal
PL-REG-ADD-10.description: Checks that a value entered in the project's custom number field when adding a submittal is stored and shown in the list.
steps: Click 'Add Submittal', fill in spec, description, Schedule Id, a test submittal number, supplier 'LG', material '43 Inches' and 7 in the custom number field, then click 'Add'.
Search for the new submittal in Procurement Log.
expected: The message 'Submittal added successfully' appears.
The custom number column of the new row shows 7.

PL-REG-ADD-11.title: Spec value fills every Spec Section No column
PL-REG-ADD-11.description: Checks that the spec number entered on a submittal appears in every 'Spec Section No' column of the list.
steps: Find the new test submittal's row in Procurement Log and read the 'Spec Section No' columns.
expected: Every 'Spec Section No' column shows the spec number entered for the submittal.

PL-REG-ADD-12.title: Create a new material and attach it
PL-REG-ADD-12.description: Checks that a material created from the submittal detail is added to that submittal.
steps: In the 'New material' form choose the first category, enter a test material name, unit 'Pieces' and lead time 1 week, then click 'Add'.
expected: The message 'Material added to submittal.' appears and the 'Materials:' line lists the new material.

PL-REG-ALR-01.title: Create an alert rule
PL-REG-ALR-01.description: Checks that an alert rule can be created on a submittal and appears in its alert table.
steps: Search for a test submittal, open the row action menu, choose 'Alert', then 'Add Alert'; choose the first field, condition '>=', value 5, enter a message and click 'Submit'.
Open Procurement Log from the left menu.
expected: The message 'Alert created successfully!' appears and the alert is shown in the table.
The Procurement Log list is shown again.

PL-REG-ALR-02.title: Create Alert checks required fields
PL-REG-ALR-02.description: Checks that submitting an empty alert form shows which fields are required instead of a general failure.
steps: Search for the test submittal, choose 'Alert' in the row menu, click 'Add Alert', then click 'Submit' without filling anything in.
expected: Required-field messages are shown and no 'Failed to create alert' message appears.
PL-REG-ALR-02.actual: The message 'Failed to create alert. Please try again.' appeared instead of required-field messages. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-068.

PL-REG-ALR-03.title: Edit an alert rule
PL-REG-ALR-03.description: Checks that an existing alert rule's value can be changed.
steps: Reload, search for the test submittal, choose 'Alert' then 'Add Alert' in the row menu; choose the first field, condition '>=', value 999, a message, and click 'Submit'; then click the rule's edit (pencil) button, change the value to 998 and submit.
expected: The message 'Alert created successfully!' appears and, after the edit, the row shows 998.

PL-REG-ALR-04.title: Delete an alert rule
PL-REG-ALR-04.description: Checks that an alert rule can be deleted from the submittal's alert list.
steps: Click the delete (bin) button on the test alert row and confirm if asked.
expected: The row disappears.

PL-REG-ALR-05.title: A met alert rule appears on the Management Dashboard
PL-REG-ALR-05.description: Checks that when an alert rule's condition is met, the alert is sent and shown in Management Dashboard Alerts.
steps: Reload, search for the test submittal, choose 'Alert' then 'Add Alert' in the row menu; choose the first field, condition '>=', value 0 (always met), a message, and click 'Submit'.
Open Management Dashboard from the left menu, then 'Alerts', and look through the first 3 pages.
expected: The message 'Alert created successfully!' appears and the rule's status becomes 'Sent'.
An alert with the test message is listed.
PL-REG-ALR-05.actual: As expected. The alert was listed dated 22/11/2026.

PL-REG-CMP-01.title: Add component requires date and quantity
PL-REG-CMP-01.description: Checks that a component cannot be added without a required-on-site date and a quantity, so incomplete components are not created.
steps: Open Procurement Log, search for a test submittal created by this run and click its Spec Description cell.
Click 'Add component', then click 'ADD' with all fields empty. Close the dialog afterwards.
expected: The submittal page opens and its address points to the submittal.
The messages 'Date Req. on Site is required' and 'Quantity is required' appear.

PL-REG-CMP-02.title: Component with a PO is Ordered with the supplier lead time
PL-REG-CMP-02.description: Checks that a component added with a purchase order is shown as 'Ordered' with the supplier's lead time, its PO number and its required-on-site (ROJ) date. The component row no longer shows an Expected Delivery date, so these values are checked instead.
steps: On the submittal page, click 'Add component'; enter Date Req. on Site 28 days from today, QTY 10, Value 1000, a test PO number and PO Date today, and click 'ADD'.
Look at the new component row.
expected: A message 'Schedule added successfully!' appears.
Status is 'Ordered', lead time is '1 week', and the PO number and the ROJ date (today plus 28 days) are shown.

PL-REG-CMP-03.title: Component without a PO is Not ordered
PL-REG-CMP-03.description: Checks that a component added without a purchase order is shown as 'Not ordered', so users can see what still needs ordering.
steps: Open Procurement Log, search for a test submittal created by this run and click its description cell.
On the submittal page, click 'Add component', enter Date Req. on Site 28 days from today, QTY 10 and Value 500, leave the PO empty and click 'ADD'.
Look at the status of the new component row.
expected: The submittal page opens with an 'Add component' button.
A message 'Schedule added successfully!' appears.
The status shows 'Not ordered'.

PL-REG-CMP-04.title: Add component defaults to the primary material
PL-REG-CMP-04.description: Checks that the Add component dialog offers the submittal's primary material and that a component can then be added with it.
steps: On the submittal page, click 'Add component' and look at the material options, then close the dialog.
Click 'Add component' again; choose the run's test material, enter Date Req. on Site 28 days from today, QTY 10, Value 1000, a test PO number and PO Date today, and click 'ADD'.
expected: The dialog shows a material button marked '(primary)'.
A message 'Schedule added successfully!' appears.

PL-REG-CMP-05.title: Currency defaults to the project currency
PL-REG-CMP-05.description: Checks that a new component uses the project's currency by default, so values are recorded in the right currency.
steps: Click 'Add component' and look at the currency selection, then close the dialog.
expected: 'Project default' with the project currency is selected.

PL-REG-CMP-06.title: Lead time update is saved and confirmed

Add two photos, click 'Save Progress' and reopen the form for editing.
Click 'Submit Inspection'.
expected: Save Progress succeeds; Submit shows a photo message and the inspection is not submitted.
Both photo thumbnails are shown.
The inspection is submitted and the Inspection Detail page opens.

PM-REG-FDI-05d.title: Spec documents shown as thumbnails
PM-REG-FDI-05d.description: Checks that linked spec documents appear on the inspection form when the setting is on, and are hidden when it is off.
steps: For a delivery whose submittal has a Spec Section No with linked documents, tick or untick 'Provide Link to Submittal Spec Documents?', click 'Save' and open the inspection form.
expected: With Yes, the linked documents are shown as thumbnails with file names; with No, the spec document section does not appear.
PM-REG-FDI-05d.actual: Not run: no test delivery has a submittal whose Spec Section No has linked documents.
PM-REG-FDI-05d.needed: A delivery whose submittal has a Spec Section No with documents linked in Document Management is needed.

PM-REG-FDI-05e.title: New question appears on the inspection form
PM-REG-FDI-05e.description: Checks that an enabled question added to the right question set appears on the inspection form in the set's order.
steps: Add a test question (Text) to the question set that covers the delivery's material, then open the inspection form.
expected: The question is shown with a text answer field, in the set's order (grouped questions first, ungrouped last).
PM-REG-FDI-05e.actual: Not run: the question set that covers the test material still has to be identified and a question added to it.
PM-REG-FDI-05e.needed: Automation work is needed to find the question set covering the test material and add a test question to it.

PM-REG-FDI-05f.title: Deleted or other-category questions not shown
PM-REG-FDI-05f.description: Checks that deleted questions and questions from another category's set do not appear on the inspection form.
steps: Delete the test question added in PM-REG-FDI-05e.
Also pick a question that belongs only to another category's set, then open a new inspection form.
expected: Neither question is shown.
PM-REG-FDI-05f.actual: Not run: it depends on PM-REG-FDI-05e, which was not run.
PM-REG-FDI-05f.needed: Automation work is needed: PM-REG-FDI-05e must run first so its test question can be deleted and checked.

PM-REG-FDI-05g.title: Photo uploads off hides the Photos section
PM-REG-FDI-05g.description: Checks that inspectors cannot add photos when photo uploading is switched off.
steps: In FDI Settings set 'Enable Uploading of Photos?' to No (with 'Photos are mandatory?' No), click 'Save' and reopen the inspection form.
expected: There is no 'Add photo' option on the form.

PM-REG-FDI-05h.title: Upload accepts jpg, png, pdf, xlsx and csv
PM-REG-FDI-05h.description: Checks that the inspection form accepts and lists files of all five expected types.
steps: In FDI Settings set 'Enable Uploading of Photos?' to Yes and click 'Save'. On the inspection form add one file each of type .jpg, .png, .pdf, .xlsx and .csv.
expected: Every file is listed on the form.
PM-REG-FDI-05h.actual: Only the two image files appeared on the form; the pdf, xlsx and csv files were not listed, and no message said they were refused. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-080.

PM-REG-FDI-05i.title: Photo thumbnails in edit and view mode
PM-REG-FDI-05i.description: Checks that photos added to an inspection are shown as thumbnails both while editing and on the submitted report.
steps: Open the Inspection Detail of the report submitted in PM-REG-FDI-05c.
expected: The photo thumbnails are shown in view mode, as they were in edit mode.
PM-REG-FDI-05i.actual: As expected. Two images were shown in both edit and view mode.

PM-REG-FDI-05j.title: Photo popup with Next and Previous
PM-REG-FDI-05j.description: Checks that a photo opens full size and the user can move between photos without closing the popup.
steps: On the Inspection Detail page, click the first photo thumbnail, then use Next and Previous.
expected: A full-size popup opens and Next and Previous move between the photos without closing it.

PM-REG-FDI-05k.title: Spec document opens in a viewer
PM-REG-FDI-05k.description: Checks that clicking a spec document on the inspection form opens it for viewing.
steps: With the spec document setting on, click a spec document thumbnail on the inspection form.
expected: The document opens in a popup viewer.
PM-REG-FDI-05k.actual: Not run: no linked spec document is available to open.
PM-REG-FDI-05k.needed: The same test data as PM-REG-FDI-05d is needed: a linked spec document to open.

PM-REG-FDI-05l.title: Spec document link with no documents linked
PM-REG-FDI-05l.description: Checks that the inspection form clearly says when no spec documents are linked, and hides the section when the setting is off.
steps: In FDI Settings set 'Provide Link to Submittal Spec Documents?' to Yes, click 'Save' and open the inspection form of a test delivery whose submittal has a Spec Section No but no documents.
Set 'Provide Link to Submittal Spec Documents?' to No, click 'Save' and reopen the form.
expected: The form shows 'No documents linked for this Spec Section No.' and no error.
There is no 'Submittal Spec Documents' section.

PM-REG-FDI-05m.title: Message when the submittal has no Spec Section No
PM-REG-FDI-05m.description: Checks that the inspection form shows a clear message when the submittal has no Spec Section No.
steps: Switch the spec document setting on.
Open the inspection form of a delivery whose submittal has an empty Spec Section No.
expected: Exactly 'No Spec Section No provided in submittal.' is shown, with no error.
PM-REG-FDI-05m.actual: Not run: every submittal created by the test run has a Spec Section No.
PM-REG-FDI-05m.needed: A delivery whose submittal has an empty Spec Section No is needed.

PM-REG-FDI-05n.title: Submitted report keeps its original settings
PM-REG-FDI-05n.description: Checks that changing a setting later does not alter inspection reports that were already submitted.
steps: In FDI Settings set 'Need Overall Notes to be captured' and uploads to Yes and 'Photos are mandatory?' to No. Open a new form, enter a test note, answer all questions and submit.
Set 'Need Overall Notes to be captured' to No and click 'Save'. Open the submitted report, then a new form.
expected: The Inspection Detail shows the test note.
The submitted report still shows the test note; the new form has no notes field.
PM-REG-FDI-05n.actual: After the setting was switched to No, the already submitted report no longer showed its notes. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-079.

PM-REG-FDI-06.title: FDI settings saved on another project
PM-REG-FDI-06.description: Checks that FDI settings can be changed and saved on a second project, as settings are per project.
steps: On project SCP_Testing_Ram, in FDI Settings, change 'Need Overall Notes to be captured', click 'Save' and reload.
expected: The changed value is kept.

PM-REG-FDI-06b.title: NRVC_Hall unaffected by other project's settings
PM-REG-FDI-06b.description: Checks that changing settings on one project does not change another project's settings.
steps: Use the project selector to switch back to NRVC_Hall.
Open 'Configuration Options' and look at 'Currency Type'.
Open 'First Delivery Inspection Config' and look at FDI Settings.
expected: The project loads.
The original currency is still shown.
The FDI Settings match their original values.

PM-REG-FDI-06c.title: Restore the other project's FDI setting
PM-REG-FDI-06c.description: Checks that the setting changed on SCP_Testing_Ram during testing is put back to its original value.
steps: Use the project selector to switch to SCP_Testing_Ram.
In FDI Settings, set 'Need Overall Notes to be captured' back to its original value, click 'Save' and reload.
Switch back to NRVC_Hall.
expected: The project loads.
The original value is restored (nothing to do if it was unchanged).
The project loads.

PM-REG-FDI-07.title: Default settings on an unconfigured project
PM-REG-FDI-07.description: Checks that a project where FDI was never configured starts with all FDI settings switched off.
steps: Switch to project SCP_Testing_Ram, go to Project Management and open 'First Delivery Inspection Config'.
Look at the four FDI Settings checkboxes.
expected: The page opens.
All four are unticked and 'Photos are mandatory?' is greyed out.

PM-REG-FDI-10.title: Inspector table columns and row states
PM-REG-FDI-10.description: Checks that the inspector table shows the right columns and only valid combinations of status, enabled state and action button.
steps: On First Delivery Inspection Config, look at the inspector table headings.
For each inspector row, look at the Status, Enabled and action button.
expected: The columns are Name / Email, Role, Materials Scope, Status, Enabled and Actions.
Each row shows one of: 'Active / Enabled / Disable', 'Active / Disabled / Enable', or 'Invited - Pending Acceptance / Disabled' with a greyed-out 'Enable' button.

PM-REG-FDI-11.title: Invite form opens with Send disabled
PM-REG-FDI-11.description: Checks that the Invite button opens the invitation form and invitations cannot be sent while the form is empty.
steps: On First Delivery Inspection Config, click 'Invite'.
Look at the tabs and the send button on the 'Invite Users' form.
expected: The 'Invite Users' form opens.
The tabs 'Manual entry' and 'From Procore directory' are shown, and 'Send Invites' is greyed out.

PM-REG-FDI-12.title: Invalid email blocks Send Invites
PM-REG-FDI-12.description: Checks that an invitation cannot be sent to a badly formed email address.
steps: On the 'Invite Users' form, replace the email with 'not-an-email'.
expected: 'Send Invites' is greyed out.

PM-REG-FDI-13.title: Role is required to send an invite
PM-REG-FDI-13.description: Checks that an invitation cannot be sent without choosing a role for the person.
steps: On First Delivery Inspection Config, click 'Invite' and enter a test user's email without choosing a role.
expected: 'Send Invites' is greyed out.

PM-REG-FDI-14.title: Valid email and role enable Send Invites
PM-REG-FDI-14.description: Checks that the invitation can be sent once a valid email and a role are given.
steps: On the 'Invite Users' form, with a valid email entered, choose the role 'Project User' (do not send).
expected: 'Send Invites' becomes available.

PM-REG-FDI-15.title: Empty extra invite row blocks Send Invites
PM-REG-FDI-15.description: Checks that invitations cannot be sent while an added user row is still empty.
steps: On the 'Invite Users' form, enter a test user's email and click 'Add Another User'.
Close the form with Cancel or X.
expected: A second email row appears and 'Send Invites' is greyed out again.
The form closes and nothing is sent.

PM-REG-FDI-16.title: Invite form role options
PM-REG-FDI-16.description: Checks that the role dropdown on the Invite form offers the expected project roles.
steps: On the 'Invite Users' form, enter a test user's email and open the 'Choose Role' dropdown.
expected: The roles All_Role_Access, Project Admin, Project Manager, Project Senior User, Project User, Subcontractor and Supplier are offered.
PM-REG-FDI-16.actual: As expected. The list also included a role named 'SCP Automation Test Role'.

PM-REG-FDI-16a.title: Invite organisation list has no duplicates
PM-REG-FDI-16a.description: Checks that each organisation appears only once in the Invite form so the user picks the right one.
steps: On the 'Invite Users' form, open the 'Choose Organization' dropdown.
expected: Each organisation name appears only once.
PM-REG-FDI-16a.actual: Several organisation names appeared more than once in the list: Amazon, Bulldozer, Meta, Neuralrays, NR and NR-test. Recorded as defect SCP-DEF-023.

PM-REG-FDI-17.title: Invite from Procore directory tab
PM-REG-FDI-17.description: Checks that the Procore directory tab of the Invite form shows its search controls and default-role note.
steps: On the 'Invite Users' form, click 'From Procore directory'.
Close the form with Cancel or X.
expected: A note that users get the Subcontractor role by default, a 'Search' button, 'No users returned' and 'Add to invite list' are shown.
The form closes and nothing is sent.

PM-REG-FDI-18.title: Invited inspector accepts, becomes active, then disabled
PM-REG-FDI-18.description: Checks the full life of an invited inspector: pending until accepted, active automatically after acceptance, and unable to self-assign once disabled.
steps: Invite an inspector, accept the invitation from the email, complete the profile and sign in as that inspector.
After acceptance, reload First Delivery Inspection Config, then disable the inspector.
expected: The inspector shows as pending and disabled until the invitation is accepted.
After acceptance the inspector shows Active and Enabled without any admin action; once disabled, they cannot self-assign.
PM-REG-FDI-18.actual: Not run: it needs an invitation to be accepted from the test mailbox and the inspector to sign in.
PM-REG-FDI-18.needed: An inspector account that can sign in is needed, because the test mailbox site blocks automated acceptance of invitations.

PM-REG-FDI-19.title: Inviting an already invited email
PM-REG-FDI-19.description: Checks that inviting the same email again does not create a duplicate inspector row.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspection Config, click 'Invite', enter the email of a person already invited by this run with role 'Project User' and click 'Send Invites'.
Close the form and reload the page.
expected: The outcome is recorded.
There is still only one row for that email.
PM-REG-FDI-19.actual: As expected. The form closed without a message and no duplicate row was created.

PM-REG-FDI-20.title: Add Inspector form fields and scope options
PM-REG-FDI-20.description: Checks that the Add Inspector form asks for member, role and materials scope with the three scope choices.
steps: On First Delivery Inspection Config, click 'Add Inspector'.
Look at the fields on the form.
Close the form without adding anyone.
expected: The 'Add Inspector' form opens.
Required fields 'Project Member', 'Project Role' and 'Materials Scope' are shown, with the options 'All Materials', 'By Material Category' and 'Specific Materials'; the first option is selected.
The form closes.

PM-REG-FDI-21.title: Add Inspector requires member and role
PM-REG-FDI-21.description: Checks that an inspector cannot be added without both a project member and a project role.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspection Config. Click 'Add Inspector', choose a Project Role but no Project Member, and click 'Add'.
On the 'Add Inspector' form, choose a Project Member but no Project Role, and click 'Add'.
expected: The form stays open and nobody is added.
The form stays open and the member is not added to the table.
PM-REG-FDI-21.actual: As expected. Both times the message 'Select a project member and a role.' was shown.

PM-REG-FDI-22.title: Inspector scope by material category is shown
PM-REG-FDI-22.description: Checks that an inspector added with a material category scope shows that category in the table.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspection Config and look at the third inspector added by this run (scope 'By Material Category').
expected: The Materials Scope cell shows the test category created by this run, with all its materials.

PM-REG-FDI-23.title: Disable and re-enable an inspector
PM-REG-FDI-23.description: Checks that an inspector can be disabled and enabled again, and that their role is kept.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspection Config. On the first test inspector's row click 'Disable', confirm and reload.
On the same row click 'Enable', confirm and reload.
expected: Enabled shows 'Disabled' and the role is unchanged.
Enabled shows 'Enabled' and the role is unchanged.

PM-REG-FDI-24.title: Change an inspector's materials
PM-REG-FDI-24.description: Checks that the specific materials an inspector covers can be changed and saved.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspection Config. On the second test inspector's row click 'Edit materials', switch off the current material and switch on another, click 'Save' and reload.
expected: The scope shows only the newly chosen material.
PM-REG-FDI-24.actual: As expected. No message was shown on saving.

PM-REG-FDI-25.title: Add several inspectors with different scopes
PM-REG-FDI-25.description: Checks that several inspectors can be added, each with a different materials scope.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspection Config. Click 'Add Inspector', choose a free project member and a role, select 'All Materials' and click 'Add'.
Add a second free member with a role and the scope 'Specific Materials'.
Add a third free member with a role and the scope 'By Material Category'.
expected: A row shows the member with that role.
A row shows the member with that role.
A row shows the member with that role.

PM-REG-FDI-25a.title: Inspectors remain after leaving the page
PM-REG-FDI-25a.description: Checks that added inspectors are still listed after moving to another page and coming back.
steps: From First Delivery Inspection Config, open 'Inventory Control', then open 'First Delivery Inspection Config' again.
Look at the inspector table.
expected: The inspectors page loads again.
The three inspectors added by this run are still listed.

PM-REG-FDI-25c.title: Inspector table with one or several inspectors
PM-REG-FDI-25c.description: Checks that the inspector table displays correctly both with a single inspector and with several.
steps: On First Delivery Inspection Config for SCP_Testing_Ram, look at the inspector table.
expected: Exactly one inspector row is shown here, while NRVC_Hall showed more than one.

PM-REG-FDI-26.title: Invite several people at once
PM-REG-FDI-26.description: Checks that several people can be invited as inspectors in one go and appear as pending.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspection Config, click 'Invite', enter two test users' emails (using 'Add Another User'), choose 'Project User' for each and click 'Send Invites'.
Look at the inspector table.
expected: The form closes.
Both invited people show 'Invited - Pending Acceptance', Enabled 'Disabled' and a greyed-out 'Enable' button.

PM-REG-FDI-26a.title: Invites from User Management are unaffected
PM-REG-FDI-26a.description: Checks that inviting someone from User Management still works as before and does not add them to the FDI inspectors list.
steps: Go to User Management and invite a test user's email with a role.
expected: The invitation is sent as before and the person is not added to the FDI Inspectors list.
PM-REG-FDI-26a.actual: Not run: it is a check across modules that needs the User Management invitation to be completed.
PM-REG-FDI-26a.needed: A test mailbox whose invitation can be accepted is needed, as for the User Management invite test UM-REG-09.

PM-REG-FDI-27.title: Inspector scope: several materials, then All Materials
PM-REG-FDI-27.description: Checks that an inspector can cover several specific materials and can then be changed to all materials.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspection Config. On the second test inspector's row click 'Edit materials', add another material, click 'Save' and reload.
Click 'Edit materials' again, tick 'All Materials', click 'Save' and reload.
expected: The scope shows both chosen materials.
The scope reads 'All Materials'.

PM-REG-FDI-28.title: Disabled or pending inspectors cannot self-assign
PM-REG-FDI-28.description: Checks that only active, enabled inspectors are offered for self-assigning an inspection.
steps: Disable an inspector who covers the run's material, reload, sign in as that inspector and open an unassigned record in First Delivery Inspections.
Check that an inspector whose invitation is still pending is not offered either.
Re-enable the inspector and reload.
expected: The disabled inspector is not offered for self-assign.
The pending inspector is not offered.
The inspector is offered again.
PM-REG-FDI-28.actual: Not run: it needs the inspector to sign in and an FDI record.

PM-REG-FDI-28a.description: Checks that disabling an inspector does not remove them from inspections already assigned to them.

expected: The record still shows that inspector as auditor; only new selection is restricted.
PM-REG-FDI-28a.actual: Not run: it needs an FDI record that is already assigned to an inspector.

PM-REG-FDI-29a.title: Pending invited inspectors cannot be enabled
PM-REG-FDI-29a.description: Checks that an inspector who has not yet accepted the invitation stays disabled and the page explains when they will become active.
steps: In the inspector table, look at rows with the status 'Invited - Pending Acceptance'.
expected: Enabled shows 'Disabled', the action button is greyed out and its tooltip reads 'Activates automatically once the invite is accepted'.

PM-REG-FDI-30.title: Warning when no catch-all question set exists
PM-REG-FDI-30.description: Checks that administrators are warned when no question set covers all categories.
steps: On First Delivery Inspection Config, look at the question set area.
expected: A warning starting 'No All Categories set' is shown.

PM-REG-FDI-31.description: Checks that the New Question Set form offers a name field and category choices, and blocks categories already used by another set.

Look at the fields on the form.
expected: The 'New FDI Inspection Question Set' form opens.

PM-REG-FDI-32.description: Checks that a question set cannot be created without a name or without at least one material category.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspection Config, click 'New Question Set', note the list of categories and close the form.
Open 'New Question Set' again and submit it with an empty name.
Submit the form with a name but no category.
expected: The category list is recorded for later checks.
The form stays open and no set is created.
The form stays open and no set is created.

PM-REG-FDI-33.title: Question set name limited to 200 characters
PM-REG-FDI-33.description: Checks that a question set name cannot be longer than 200 characters.
steps: On the New Question Set form, type 201 characters into 'Set Name'.
Close the form with Cancel or X.
expected: The field keeps only 200 characters.
The form closes and no set is created.

PM-REG-FDI-34.title: Create a question set for a free category
PM-REG-FDI-34.description: Checks that a question set can be created for an unused category and that the category is then marked as taken.

Open 'New Question Set' again, search for the same category, then close the form.
expected: The form closes and a tab for the new set appears.

PM-REG-FDI-35.title: Manage Groups opens and closes the groups table
PM-REG-FDI-35.description: Checks that the question groups list can be shown and hidden and shows the number of groups stated on the button.

Click 'Manage Groups' again.
expected: A groups table with a 'Heading Display Text' column shows the stated number of rows.

Click the up arrow on the second group.

expected: Both groups appear in the groups table.

PM-REG-FDI-37.description: Checks that all supported answer types can be chosen for a new inspection question.

Open the 'Choose Answer Type' dropdown.
Close the form with Cancel or X.
expected: The 'Add Question' form opens.
The types Boolean, Text, Date, Pass/Fail/NA, Numeric, Drop Down, Single Photo, Multiple Photo and Document are offered.
The form closes and nothing is added.

PM-REG-FDI-38.title: Add Question requires text and answer type
PM-REG-FDI-38.description: Checks that a question cannot be added without question text or without an answer type.
steps: Open First Delivery Inspection Config, select the run's question set, click 'Add Question' and submit with empty Question Text.
Submit the 'Add Question' form with no Answer Type.
expected: The form stays open and the question is not added.
The form stays open and the question is not added.
PM-REG-FDI-38.actual: As expected. The messages were 'Question Text is required' and 'Answer Type is required'.

PM-REG-FDI-39.title: New question is enabled straight away

Look at the Questions table.
expected: The form closes.

Look at the Questions table.
Open 'Add from Organization Bank' again.
expected: The question is added.
The bank question is listed as 'Enabled'.
The question just added is no longer offered.

PM-REG-FDI-41.title: Reorder a question and move it to a group
PM-REG-FDI-41.description: Checks that a question can be moved up the list and assigned to a group, and that the group is kept.

In the Questions table, set this question's Group to the run's test group and reload.
expected: The question is added and moves up.

PM-REG-FDI-42.title: Delete a question

expected: The question row is removed.

PM-REG-FDI-42a.title: Deleted questions appear when shown

expected: The deleted test question is listed with status 'Deleted'.

PM-REG-FDI-42b.title: Show and hide deleted questions

expected: The number of rows is at least the number of active questions.
